symbols.name: AuthorizationRolesPipelineBehavior
symbols.summary: Pipeline behavior that enforces role-based authorization for a specific handler, based on BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.HandlerAuthorizeRolesAttribute discovered in the BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PolicyConfig for the handler type.
symbols.remarks: Behavior semantics: - If no roles are configured on the handler, the behavior is a no-op. - Requires the current principal to be authenticated; otherwise returns a failed result with BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.UnauthorizedError. - OR semantics across roles: the user must be in at least one of the configured roles. - On role check failure, returns a failed result with BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.ForbiddenError. - This behavior is handler-specific (see BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.AuthorizationRolesPipelineBehavior%602.IsHandlerSpecific). Place this behavior early in the pipeline to avoid doing work for unauthorized requests.

syntax.content: public sealed class AuthorizationRolesPipelineBehavior : PipelineBehaviorBase, IPipelineBehavior where TRequest : class where TResponse : IResult

symbols.name: Process(TRequest, Type, Func>, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Executes the role-based authorization check for the given handler. Returns a failed TResponse with BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.UnauthorizedError if not authenticated, or BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.ForbiddenError if the user is not a member of any required role. If no roles are configured, invokes the next stage.
